t: A tiny open hardware FPGA board in the Feather shape with lots of memory.
steps: Look for leftover stock at Farnell, element14 or DigiKey. New boards sold for about 119 to 178 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the open tools Yosys, nextpnr and Project Trellis.
Install dfu-util to load designs over USB.
Build the blink example and load it with dfu-util.
Try the LiteX RISC-V example next.
meta: Wild Open. From $75. A few stores.
